messages:
leo-sales: CrescentBank emailed asking for both SOC 2 Type II artifacts and ISO 27001 scope docs for the POC. Theyre also asking for the signed pen-test letter and "raw" findings if possible. They want dev on Hosted and prod on Dedicated with separate billing. Any blockers?

maria-se: We can provide the SOC2 summary report and ISO scope statement (redacted org names). Raw pen-test findings -- we avoid handing those out. We can provide a signed attestation + a remediation summary. If they insist on findings, they need an NDA + a redaction plan and request via our secure dataroom.

devsecops: For Dedicated, note that spinning a short-term reserved pool in ap-southeast requires capacity checks. We can offer a daily pro-rate with a 24h minimum for POCs. Also need to confirm whether they want SAML/IdP integration or just API keys for the POC. SAML will add 2-3 business days.

alice-legal: Pen-test letter: we will sign standard template once scope is clear. We need the testers' company name + signatory and whether the scan is external-only or also internal. Link to template (internal): https://redwood.internal/legal/pen-test-letter. If customer requests findings, we require: NDA signed by their legal entity, approved requester, and data-handling checklist.

billing-bot: Provisional pricing notes: Hosted = per-token; Dedicated = reserved GPU pool pro-rated daily. Example: 1 x A100-equivalent reserved node = $X/day (provisional). For a precise quote we need expected concurrent sessions and avg tokens per session.

leo-sales: OK I'll ask them to confirm scope + provide test firm details and QPS. Can we paste a short ask template I can send?

maria-se: Paste this:

```
Please provide:
- Pen-test scope: external / internal / both
- Pen-test firm name + signatory name, title, email
- Desired evidence: attestation only / attestation + findings (if findings, attach NDA signed PDF)
- POC traffic: expected concurrent requests (QPS) and avg tokens per request
- Regions needed: Hosted region (e.g., eu-west) and Dedicated region (if different)
- SSO requirement: API keys or SAML/OIDC integration?
- Any data residency / export controls to note
```

leo-sales: Nice. Also, for the dataroom: do we have a presigned S3 flow for uploading artifacts?

evidence-bot: Created ticket EVD-9901 to assemble SOC2 summary, ISO scope, system diagrams, and pen-test attestation once inputs are provided. Owner: @devsecops.

devsecops: We can provide a presigned S3 upload for them to drop NDA-signed findings if legal approves. Otherwise we will not accept raw scan exports via email.

billing-bot: One more note: split billing will require a short contract amendment (adds Dedicated line item). Procurement often asks for a vendor form  please have their procurement contact ready.

aleo-sales: (typo) leo-sales: will ping CrescentBank now. Expect reply within 48h. :rocket:
